subtitle: Prototypes focused on industrial software and system integration

description.summary: Integration layer between PLC systems and web-based applications for real-time industrial data access.
description.context: Integration layer between industrial PLC systems and web-based monitoring tools.
description.challenge: Managing concurrent reads while keeping response times predictable and avoiding load on PLCs.
description.solution: Node.js backend with controlled polling strategy and Next.js frontend for structured data access.

description.summary: Desktop application for real-time control and monitoring of PLC systems via industrial communication protocols.
description.context: Development of a lightweight control interface for machine-level operations in industrial environments.
description.challenge: Ensuring safe command execution over unstable network communication with PLC devices.
description.solution: Built an Electron-based client with controlled state handling and asynchronous communication patterns.

description.summary: Embedded and IoT systems development for sensing, control, and real-time data transmission over WiFi to cloud platforms.
description.context: Design and implementation of hardware-software systems integrating sensors, actuators, microcontrollers, and enclosure design with network connectivity.
description.challenge: Working under memory and processing constraints while ensuring reliable device behavior and stable communication over WiFi networks.
description.solution: Implemented optimized C/C++ firmware for sensor reading and actuator control, including WiFi connectivity (ESP32), data transmission to cloud platforms (ThingSpeak), and enclosure design using 3D modeling and printing.
description.focus: Embedded Control, IoT Connectivity & Edge Systems
